# S78 — recoverRuns writes the run map under the manager lock

recoverRuns (internal/daemon/runs.go:118-157) writes d.runs.runs in its loop (:143-152) without the manager lock, then takes the lock only for startQueuedLocked (:153-155). It is safe today only because it runs before the server starts (daemon.go:176). Noted in the S05 run report.

**Findings:**  · **Size:** S `[needs-owner]` · **Tree:**

**Not in this slice:**

## Why

Every other write to the run map happens under d.runs.mu. A later change that calls recoverRuns after the server starts would race.

## Files

- `internal/daemon/runs.go`: recoverRuns (:118-157).
- `internal/daemon/runs_test.go`: a test, if one can show the write is locked.

## Failing tests

- Not specified. Open: whether a test can fail before the change. The writes run before the server starts, so a race test may need a goroutine that reads the run map under the lock while recoverRuns runs. If none is practical, this slice may be a comment and a lock with no failing test; the owner decides.

## Implement

Take d.runs.mu around each write to d.runs.runs in the loop, not around Reconcile (it can be slow). Open: whether to do this at all, or only document the "before the server starts" assumption at the function. The owner has not decided.
